text:
maria: Quick plan — run a 48h 'accelerator' funnel for new signups: 20 starter credits + 3 tiny prompts + 15-min on-demand demo. goal: first-success <24h and lift in week-1 retention.
ashley: thumbs up. two creative lanes: ‘build’ (code examples) and ‘create’ (marketing copy). will A/B CTA wording.
jon: routing: capture 'primary_use' at signup; embed users -> embed pack; otherwise gen pack. keep rules simple.
sam: ops: credits expire in 7d, throttle new accounts to 75rpm. create experiment flag accel_48_v1.
maria: cadence: 0h email + credits + CTA, 6h in-app nudge w/ 1-click prompt pack, 18h reminder + demo link, 48h last-chance. compressed window.
ashley: subject lines to test: "20 credits to try Redwood in minutes" vs "Try these 3 prompts — instant result". A/B top 2.
jon: metrics: activation = first_success event; target 30% within 24h. track cost per activated user; include model_name in analytics.
maria: infra checklist: create flag, wire events (credits_granted, prompt_used, first_success, demo_viewed), tag cohort + variant.
growth-bot: experiment created accel_48_v1 id: exp_20260910_1. traffic: 10% initial, auto-ramp rules set.
sam: rollout plan: soft-launch Fri 9am PT at 10%, monitor 24h, ramp to 35% if healthy. alert if first_success <22% or cost/activation > $1.
maria: prompt-pack rules: 3 prompts max, include seed input + 1-line expected outcome. store immutable pack PromptPack_accel_v1.
ashley: deliverables: email A/B, in-app copy, 3 prompts per lane, 15m demo + 30s highlight clip. deadline: Wed EOD.
jon: I'll add signup field and QA event keys.
sam: I'll wire flag, quotas, and alerts; will post runbook snippet.
maria: thanks. keep replies short, i'll drop prompt drafts here for review. :rocket:
